notes.title: Bugfix Patch - 2022-07-26
notes.content:
Hello doods,

We've published a small bugfix patch for the PC version of ZHP: Unlosing Ranger vs. Darkdeath Evilman!

Fixes


Fixed an issue with auto save failing when starting a new game and not saving manually at least once.
Fixed multiple issues with BGM playback.
Fixed an issue with name input in Japanese mode.


Have a good day!
